observations: Connected: status, disconnect and scoped explanation fit the card.
Error: wrapped heading, retry and repair actions remain visible.
Idle dark: primary action and 500ms explanation fit without overlap.
Idle light: blue action and text remain readable on white cards.
Large narrow: enlarged text wraps without horizontal overflow; action remains visible; content scrolls.
Maintenance confirm: delete and cancel are separate; cache-only scope is readable.
Maintenance preview: both actions and 18-byte preview fit the card.
Maintenance result: deletion result wraps cleanly with protected-data explanation.
Partial: amber warning is distinct from connected success; disconnect visible.
RU large: heading does not overlap switch; provider visibility warning wraps.
RU off: disabled state is explained in text, domain list stays inside card.
RU on: direct routing and reconnection scope readable, domains contained.
RU Tor: text explicitly states exclusions are disabled despite saved toggle.
Search progress: scroll state has separate cards and visible Stop action.
Searching: cancel action prominent; ongoing search explanation fits.
Services: 700ms Telegram is amber and local-probe limitation readable; metrics contained.
scope: Synthetic states of production Compose on Android emulator; not live VPN, operator DPI or release version-label verification.
